notes.title: May 23 update:
notes.content:
Hey all!

To meet your expectations, we prepared an important update on May 23, which was partially repaired and optimized, and added many new features. we hope you like it!

[b][h1]Added[/h1][/b]
· Adjust the checkpoint flow and terrain
· Add new effects at checkpoint 
· Added Italian, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Korean, Portuguese, and multiple languages
· Achievement in the game, add an achievement badge on the Steam personal page

[b][h1]repair[/h1][/b]
·Fixed the first time to take props, props will not automatically into the backpack.
·Fix the beach's 3D sound

[b][h1]optimization[/h1][/b]
·Other kinds of display optimization

This is so far. Please let us know what you think! More updates are in progress.

[b][h1]【contact】[/h1][/b]
[Twitter]https://twitter.com/iblackholes
[Facebook] https://www.facebook.com/MIAvrGame/
